payload.reason: The evidence explains the difference between human evaluation accuracy and automatic evaluation F1 scores, indicating that higher absolute accuracy numbers can occur due to the limitations of automatic evaluations in capturing all correct answers.

claims.text: Higher absolute accuracy numbers compared to F1 scores indicate that human evaluations can assess correctness more comprehensively than automatic evaluations, which may miss valid answers.

The discrepancy between human evaluation accuracy and automatic F1 scores arises because human evaluators can recognize multiple correct answers, while automatic evaluations rely on a fixed set of gold answers.
